evals.name: dylib-clock-plugin
evals.prompt: 在 dougong 仓库里新增一个 dylib 插件 crate clock-plugin：提供服务 clock.now，method 0 被调用时返回 JSON 字符串，内容是当前 unix 时间戳（秒）。插件只依赖 dougong-abi。把 crate 加进 workspace，保证 cargo build -p clock-plugin 产出 .so 且导出 DOUGONG_PLUGIN_EXPORTS，cargo clippy -p clock-plugin --all-targets -- -D warnings 零警告。
evals.expected_output: A new cdylib crate crates/clock-plugin depending only on dougong-abi, exporting DOUGONG_PLUGIN_EXPORTS with the 7-field table, a JSON descriptor declaring provide [clock.now], a call handler returning a JSON-quoted unix-seconds string, state via setup/teardown pair; builds to a .so with zero clippy warnings.
assertions: crates/clock-plugin exists; its Cargo.toml declares crate-type cdylib, depends on dougong-abi (path dep) and nothing else, and the crate is listed in the workspace members
cargo build -p clock-plugin exits 0 and produces a .so under target/debug
nm -D on the built .so finds the DOUGONG_PLUGIN_EXPORTS symbol
src/lib.rs defines static DOUGONG_PLUGIN_EXPORTS initializing all seven fields (abi_version with ABI_VERSION, name, descriptor, setup, call, on_event, teardown)
the descriptor JSON declares a provide list containing clock.now
all output writes go through dougong_abi::write_out and capacity overflow returns STATUS_CAPACITY (no ad-hoc pointer math)
setup allocates state via Box::into_raw and teardown releases it via Box::from_raw exactly once
cargo clippy -p clock-plugin --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0 with no output

evals.name: wasm-calc-plugin
evals.prompt: 在 dougong 仓库里新增一个 wasm 插件 crate calc-wasm：提供 calc.add 服务，method 0 收到 JSON {"a":..,"b":..} 返回 JSON 数字 a+b。参照 greeter-wasm 的做法，只依赖 wit-bindgen 和 wit/ 下的契约。要求宿主 target 的 cargo build --workspace 和 cargo clippy -p calc-wasm --all-targets -- -D warnings 保持零警告，并且 cargo build -p calc-wasm --target wasm32-wasip2 能产出 .wasm。
evals.expected_output: A new wasm guest crate crates/calc-wasm with cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")-gated bindings and export, a Guest impl whose descriptor declares provide calc.add with the dougong-dynamic-channel-v1 hash, handle_service_call parsing {a,b} JSON and returning the JSON sum; host-target workspace build and clippy stay green and the wasip2 artifact builds.
assertions: crates/calc-wasm exists; Cargo.toml declares crate-type cdylib with wit-bindgen as the only dependency, and the crate is listed in the workspace members
the bindings module, imp module, re-export, and export! call are all gated behind #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
the Guest descriptor declares provide containing service name calc.add with abi-hash dougong-dynamic-channel-v1
handle_service_call validates the service key, parses {"a":..,"b":..} from the JSON payload, and returns the sum encoded as a JSON number (valid JSON bytes)
apply registers the provided service via host::provide_service before returning Ok
cargo build --workspace exits 0 on the host target with calc-wasm as a member
cargo clippy -p calc-wasm --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0 with no output on the host target
cargo build -p calc-wasm --target wasm32-wasip2 exits 0 and produces a non-empty .wasm artifact
